name: Zipf and Zeta schedulers
plain: Weights steps by a power law of rank, with the exponent drifting per step, and descends by the cumulative weight. Big early jumps and a long tail. Zeta adds path shapes for the exponent.
math:
Zipf: α_r=linspace(x_start,x_end,n); w_r=r^{−α_r}, normalised. c=[0, cumsum w]; σ=(1−c)(σmax−σmin)+σmin; last=σmin. No trailing 0.
Zeta: α by path linear, poly, cosine, exp, or a pivot; w=(r^{−α})^γ (rest of the function not read).

props.params: x_start, x_end; zeta: x_start=.5, x_end=3, path_type, kappa, gamma, pivot, clip_frac, range_scale
